summaryZh: Lee 实验室研究精神分裂症和健康人群中的生物及心理社会衰老，关注衰老与睡眠、认知、孤独和代谢健康的关系。成员页记录了校友在SNOOZE研究中的睡眠数据采集，以及MIDAS/SZR01研究的Fitbit与居家睡眠测试工作。

evidence.quote: Search this site Embedded Files LEE LABORATORY TEAM Ellen E. Lee, MD Principal Investigator | Professor in Residence, Department of Psychiatry she/her Ellen E. Lee, MD, is the Estelle and Edgar Levi Memorial Chair in Aging, Professor, and Division Chief of Geriatric Psychiatry at the University of California, San Diego, and Staff Psychiatrist at the VA San Diego Healthcare System. Dr. Lee’s research focuses on biological and psychosocial aging in persons with schizophrenia and healthy aging populations, examining relationships between aging, sleep disturbances, cognition, loneliness, and metabolic health. Dr. Lee is the PI of an R01 award from the National Institute of Mental Health and grants from the Brain & Behavior Research Foundation, American Psychiatric Association, UCSD Academic Senate, Altman Clinical and Translational Research Institute, and Desert-Pacific Mental Illness Research, Education and Clinical Center. Postdoctoral Researchers Andrea Coppola Clinical Psychologist she/her I am currently an Advanced Fellow in the VA's Mental Illness Research, Education, and Clinical Center (MIRECC) and a Visiting Scholar in the Psychiatry Department at UCSD. I received my PhD in Clinical Psychology from the University of Arizona in 2024 and completed my predoctoral clinical internship at UCSD/VA San Diego. My research focuses on factors that impact social functioning in patients with Serious Mental Illness (SMI), including sleep and social cognition. In my free time, I love taking my Australian Cattle Dog on adventures, trying new restaurants, and playing various NYT word games. Emma Parrish Clinical Psychologist she/her I am currently an Advanced Fellow in the VA's Mental Illness Research, Education, and Clinical Center (MIRECC) and a Visiting Scholar in the Psychiatry Department at UCSD. I received my PhD in Clinical Psychology from the UCSD/SDSU Joint Doctoral Program in Clinical Psychology and completed my predoctoral clinical internship at the University of Washington School of Medicine. My research interests lie in understanding mechanisms related to suicide ideation and behavior among people with serious mental illness, as well as the development and implementation of psychosocial interventions for inpatient psychiatric settings. Outside of work, I enjoy rock climbing, hiking, traveling, and trying out new recipes Research Staff Jade Hawk Staff Research Manager s he/h er Hello, Everyone! I received my Bachelor of Arts in Psychology and Minor in Sociology from California State University, Long Beach, in 2020, and my Master of Arts in Psychology from San Diego State University in 2022. I have previous experience in project coordination, teaching, mentoring, and producing posters and a thesis. I have also worked with children, adolescents, young adults, older adults, and veterans. Before joining the Lee Laboratory, I was a Research Recruiter for the Green Laboratory at the West Los Angeles VA Hospital. In my spare time, I like to spend time with my Husband and my yellow Labrador Retriever, Goose. Nick Macias Phlebotomist/Recruiter he/him/they/them Hello! My name is Nick Macias and I am a Research Associate and Phlebotomist with the Lee Lab.
Professor, and Division Chief of Geriatric Psychiatry at the University of California, San Diego

In my time with the Lee Lab, I have recruited participants, conducted assessments, and collected sleep data for Dr. Lee's SNOOZE study. I am currently coordinating the SNOOZE and Psychosis and Aging study, as well as preparing for the launch of the PAP treatment trial. Additionally, I have worked on collecting sleep data on the UCSD Stein Institute's MIDAS and SZR01 studies using FitBits and home sleep testing devices.
